note: Canonical semantic production controls for candidate v0.9.4. This registry does not claim to contain reusable native templates. Each downstream artifact binds its selected kit, target, preset, exact final delivery bytes, required test evidence, and every editable or native source file actually used; unresolved implementations remain internal under OUTPUT-CLARITY-01.

roleMap.heading: native h1-h6 plus typography roles
roleMap.cta: capsule link or button; circle only when icon-only
roleMap.evidence: proximate disclosure plus stable record link
roleMap.motion: static source plus optional motion-riddim-approach-03 adapter; identity motion and motifs only through the MotifFrame component with the shared MotionController (MOTION-04, MOTIF-01…06)
roleMap.icon: one approved six-size icon set per property (FAVICON-01)

requiredImplementationControls: icon set in six sizes with web manifest and theme-color
MotifFrame wrapper with exact runtime bytes, twelve final-state SVGs, manifest job validation and one page-level MotionController
dark scale custom properties equal to the DATAVIZ-03 derivation (warm lane by its own formula)
no --scale-* or --series-* override inside the DATAVIZ-04 hue windows
